name: A workhorse stop ends its whole work tree
summary: Spoken Stop and the Stop control end the workhorse's turn, every sub-agent and every queued request, report only what they observed end, and refuse new work meanwhile; inspection reads the real turn, sub-agents and queue, so a stop is never claimed without evidence.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/qKGcB6vZ#5sWG4uuq
changes.value: A replay of one logical call is the same call only when it names the same checkout: the same arguments in another checkout are work for another workhorse. A delegation to a checkout whose workhorse has no thread that can run turns starts it first; the other three workhorse tools refuse a checkout with no ready workhorse, and say what a checkout is. stop_workhorses stops the work tree of every workhorse of the calling tab session and says what each stop observed. inspect_workhorse adds the outcome of the workhorse's last stop to what its operations read.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/9ncuT5DP#kEF4DfR4
changes.value: A workhorse works in its checkout, a directory the host admitted, so it reads that repository's AGENTS.md, skills and Codex configuration. Its thread-link key is the tab session and the checkout together. It belongs to the checkout, so it stays linked until its tab session ends. noteActiveTurn keeps the turn running on a workhorse from turn/started on its current thread to the turn/completed of the thread the turn started on, which New conversation may have left meanwhile. Its state also holds the phase of its last stop, which the work tree stop writes and reads.

value.name: Work tree stop
value.responsibility: Stops the whole work tree of a workhorse: its turn, every sub-agent it spawned and every pending request, and refuses new work until the stop ends
value.description: Spoken Stop and the Stop control run this one operation (ADR 0048). It marks the workhorse stopping before any effect, so delegation, queue additions, typed messages and New conversation are refused. It then repeats one pass until all observed work ended or the settle time ran out: read the workhorse thread, list its sub-agents at any depth through thread/list with ancestorThreadId, delete every queued request of each thread, and interrupt each running turn, the workhorse first. An interrupt acknowledgment only starts observation, and a turn that Codex does not name never proves a stop. The result is stopped, idle, partial or unconfirmed. Partial and unconfirmed name the threads that still run or could not be read and the recovery: inspect, or stop again. They keep refusing new work until a later stop succeeds. After a stop succeeds, the coordinator turn that asked for it can start no work, so only a fresh request does.

value.label: each workhorse's thread and stop phase

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/9ncuT5DP#7XZtb0wb
changes.value: Inspection reads the workhorse's turns through thread/turns/list, because a thread summary carries no turns. It reports the running turn, the request that started it, its recent progress, the sub-agents from thread/list, and the queue. It reads the queue only for the workhorse that this server created and proved, and it reports any read that failed as unavailable instead of empty. Steering reads the running workhorse turn the same way and sends it as the expected turn, so Codex refuses a turn that ended meanwhile. The coordinator's own turn never becomes the target.
